verdict.rationale: Caveman is described as an open-source skill, but nothing in the pack says its skills are plain markdown files and folders that can be read, copied, or carried to another harness. The only community item on the file format points the other way: a user describes a 'caveman.skill' binary file they could not easily read. Open-source status and plugin compatibility with other agents are adjacent claims and do not establish a plain-markdown, portable skill format.

support.subject: As a developer, skills are plain markdown files and folders I can read, copy, and carry to another harness — not a proprietary binary format
